messages:
lina: FYI canary (gcp-canary-3) showing steady memory growth on streaming toolloop runs. +200MB/hr over 3h. kv_residency counter monotonically increases, allocator maps look stable.
sam: saw something similar on yesterday's night batch. only reproduces on sessions > ~40k tokens.
rahul: do you have a pprof or heap sample? paste top 10 lines.
lina: pasting sampling output from 30m window:
```
pprof -top -cum heap.prof
  12.3MB  12.3MB  runtime.mallocgc
   8.1MB   8.1MB  github.com/redwood/runtime/kv.(*PageChain).Hold
   6.5MB   6.5MB  github.com/redwood/runtime/kv.(*Cache).Reserve
   3.2MB   3.2MB  github.com/redwood/runtime/session.(*Session).AddPrefix
```
lina: also grep from runtime log:
```
grep "pager handoff" /var/log/redwood/runtime.log | tail -n 8
2026-02-12T02:14:01Z pager: handoff page_id=0x12a3 pinned=3
2026-02-12T02:16:12Z pager: handoff page_id=0x12a3 pinned=4
2026-02-12T02:18:00Z pager: reclaim skipped page_id=0x12a3 refcnt=1
```
dora: sounds like pagechain refcounts are not being released during toolloop iteration; maybe iterators keep a pointer to slab headers. :eyes:
perf-bot: nightly-canary/gcp-canary-3 memory trend: 8.2GB -> 10.6GB (3h) (+29%).
alex: hypothesis: prefix caching + long-lived toolloop iterators pin pages; when pages fragment, GC can't coalesce and pages become sticky. paging churn increases when session length crosses bucket boundary.
tanya: can you try lowering KV_CACHE_MAX_AGE to 15m and bumping kv_page_threshold to 512 to force earlier reclamation? also run `./bin/snapshot-debug --dump-states` after 30m.
lina: starting two canaries now: (A) KV_CACHE_MAX_AGE=15m (B) KV_CACHE_MAX_AGE=60m + --kv-page-threshold=512. will run 90m.
rahul: also add `--kv-debug-pinned` to collect pinned_refs count every 5m.
deploy-bot: Started canary deployments: canary-A -> gcp-canary-4, canary-B -> gcp-canary-5 :rocket:
sam: if repro is fast, we should add metric `kv.pagechain_depth` and `kv.pinned_refs` to perf dashboard.
dora: if we confirm, patch idea: decouple iterator lifetime from page pin by snapshotting small header copy or use weak refs for session iterators.
lina: quick interim results after 45m: (A) growth ~30MB/hr (was 200MB/hr), (B) growth ~5MB/hr. adding kv-debug-pinned shows pinned_refs spike aligned with session toolloop iterations.
alex: interesting that increasing page threshold helped more than aggressive eviction. points to fragmentation/coalescing algorithm being the limiter.
tanya: great repro — can you upload `snapshot-debug` output to /tmp/kv-snapshots and share link?
lina: uploaded gz at https://artifacts.redwood/canary/3770012345-kv-snapshots.gz
rahul: looking at dump: many small free slabs not coalesced; pagechain links show alternating owners which prevents contiguous reclaim.
dora: ok action items: (1) add metrics for pagechain_length & pinned_refs (2) try coalescing pass in background to defragment small free slabs (3) small refactor to iterator to hold weak header copy. I'll file PRs.
sam: adding dashboard cards and alert if pinned_refs > 1000 for > 10m.
lina: thanks all — will run longer nightly run with coalescing debug toggles tomorrow and report.
lina: :thumbsup:
